diagnoses.label: Ambiguous representative TC selection for Q02 TAL
diagnoses.observable_evidence: In reflow-profile-compliance-toolkit/SKILL.md, Section 4 (Deterministic sensor selection) lists generic max/min tie-breaks and mentions 'coldest TAL' in a parenthetical example, but no section explicitly binds Q02's per-run TAL output (which requires a single tc_id and tal_s) to the cold-spot/worst-case representative-sensor rule. The 'Handbook where to look' checklist names 'cold spot', 'worst case', 'representative sensor' as concepts but never routes them to the TAL computation. The task Q02 schema requires exactly one tc_id per run yet the skill gives no explicit rule for which sensor to pick, unlike Q01 whose task text explicitly says 'select the most representative thermocouple value'.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Q02 TAL per-run reduction from multiple thermocouples to a single (tc_id, tal_s) pair, using the handbook's cold-spot/worst-case representative-sensor definition
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Q01 ramp-rate selection (max metric), Q03 peak selection (already covered under 'min_peak' with min_value/smallest_tc_id), Q04 conveyor feasibility, Q05 run ranking, and the shared segment-slope / time-above-threshold compute recipes which are correct as-is
diagnoses.target_section: Section 4 'Deterministic sensor selection (tie-breaks)' and/or a Q02-specific subsection under the handbook checklist
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Strengthen the target_binding mechanism by adding an explicit, Q02-scoped rule stating that the representative TC for TAL is the worst-case/cold-spot sensor (minimum TAL across TCs with the stable (min_value, smallest_tc_id) tie-break), consistent with the handbook's 'cold spot / worst case / representative sensor' guidance; keep the generic max/min tie-break table but reference it from Q02 explicitly. Do not write replacement code or presume handbook numeric values here.

overlay.composition_issue: The generic sensor-selection mechanism (Section 4) and the handbook-concept checklist both exist but are not composed with the Q02 TAL output contract, so the agent has freedom to pick max-TAL, first-TAL, or any TC. Clarifying the binding resolves ambiguity without altering compute recipes.
preservation_constraints: Mandatory execution and completion contract (five output files, final json.load verification)
Deterministic compute recipes: segment slope, time_above_threshold_s interpolation, sorting/dedup rules
Q03 min-peak selection and 'no TC data => failing' rule
Q04 conveyor feasibility rule-object scaffold and null/false fallback
Output guardrails: 2dp rounding, null for NaN/Inf, lexicographic sorting

package_assessment.rationale: The defect localizes to a single, well-scoped representative-sensor rule inside reflow-profile-compliance-toolkit/SKILL.md that can be clarified at L2 without touching data, compute recipes, or other questions' logic.
